# The Fire and the Sun

*[Iris Murdoch](../philosophers/iris-murdoch.md) · 1977 · *The Fire and the Sun: Why Plato Banished the Artists**

Drawn from her 1976 Romanes Lecture, the essay asks why [Plato](../philosophers/plato.md) banished the artists from the city. [Murdoch](../philosophers/iris-murdoch.md), a Platonist and a novelist, agrees with him about art that consoles and disagrees about great art, which she holds to be a path to truth.
